description.zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.
The information about limits on the queue.

description.zh:
作业保留时间，超过保留之间后，作业数据会被销毁。单位为天。    
取值范围：1~30。    
默认值：14。
description.en:
The retention period of jobs. After the retention period is exceeded, job data is deleted. Unit: days.\
Valid values: 1 to 30.\
Default value: 14.

description.zh: 集群用户使用的节点信息列表。
description.en: The information about the nodes that are used by cluster users.

description.zh:
PbsInfo指集群中可以设置的PBS调度信息个数。N的取值范围：0~100。

SchedInterval指调度周期，单位：秒

调度周期指运行多个作业之间时间间隔，如设置为60，表示本次作业开始运行60秒后才能开始运行下次作业。

默认值：60
description.en:
PbsInfo specifies the number of PBS schedulers that can be configured in the cluster. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.

SchedInterval specifies the scheduling period. Unit: seconds.

A scheduling period is the interval between two consecutive running jobs. If you set SchedInterval to 60, another job can be run 60 seconds after a job starts running.

Default value: 60.

description.zh: 集群调度的最大作业数。若集群排队和运行的作业数总和超过此数值则无法再继续提交作业。默认值：20000
description.en: The maximum number of jobs that can be scheduled in the cluster. If the total number of running jobs and queuing jobs exceeds the value, no more jobs can be submitted. Default value: 20000.

description.zh: 集群调度的最大排队作业数。若集群排队作业数量超过此数值则无法再继续提交作业。默认值：10000
description.en: The maximum number of queuing jobs that can be scheduled in the cluster. If the number of queuing jobs exceeds the value, no more jobs can be submitted. Default value: 10000.

description.zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过调用[ListRegions](~~188593~~)获取E-HPC支持的地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID.

You can call the [ListRegions](~~188593~~) operation to obtain the IDs of regions supported by Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC).

description.zh:
调度器名，取值范围：

- pbs
- pbs19
- slurm
- slurm19
- slurm20

> 调度器为pbs、pbs19时，PbsInfo.N.SchedInterval、PbsInfo.N.JobHistoryDuration、PbsInfo.N.ResourceLimit、PbsInfo.N.AclLimit中至少一个参数为必选；调度器为slurm、slurm19、slurm20时，SlurmInfo.N.SchedInterval、SlurmInfo.N.BackfillInterval中至少一个参数为必选。
description.en:
The name of the scheduler. Valid values:

*   pbs
*   pbs19
*   slurm
*   slurm19
*   slurm20

>  If you set Scheduler.N.SchedName to pbs or pbs19, you must specify at least one of the PbsInfo.N.SchedInterval, PbsInfo.N.JobHistoryDuration, PbsInfo.N.ResourceLimit, and PbsInfo.N.AclLimit parameters. If you set Scheduler.N.SchedName to slurm, slurm19, or slurm20, you must specify at least one of the SlurmInfo.N.SchedInterval and SlurmInfo.N.BackfillInterval parameters.

description.zh:
Backfill调度周期设置，单位：秒

默认值：60
description.en:
The backfill scheduling period. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60.

description.zh:
SlurmInfo指集群中可以设置的Slurm调度信息个数。N的取值范围：0~100。

SchedInterval指主调度周期设置，单位：秒

默认值：60
description.en:
SlurmInfo specifies the number of Slurm schedulers that can be configured in the cluster. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.

SchedInterval specifies the scheduling period. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc set-scheduler-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --pbs-info '[{"AclLimit":[{"AclUsers":"user1,user2","Queue":"workq"}],"SchedMaxQueuedJobs":10000,"SchedInterval":60,"SchedMaxJobs":20000,"JobHistoryDuration":14,"ResourceLimit":[{"User":"user1","Mem":"2gb","Cpus":2,"Queue":"workq","Nodes":2,"MaxJobs":1000}]}]' --slurm-info SchedInterval=60 BackfillInterval=60 --scheduler SchedName=pbs --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
